purpose: Machine-readable record of an immutable historical baseline and the latest independently measured code commit. Known failures are not accepted behaviour and do not justify weakening tests.
method: Every snapshot names its measured code commit. Historical baseline data is immutable. Current results live only under current_snapshot; partial test selections name their exact scope and leave all other files unverified. A ledger-only follow-up may record results measured on code commit C without claiming the ledger commit itself was measured. If code or tests change after C, current_snapshot must be rerun. Counts are never carried forward.

attribution_values.confirmed-defect: A real product or harness defect, reproduced and understood.
attribution_values.stale-fixture: The test fixture predates a product change; the product is behaving as designed.
attribution_values.platform-difference: Behaviour differs by host platform and the test does not account for it.
attribution_values.under-investigation: Observed, not yet attributed. Default state.

baseline.isolation: vitest.config.ts injects REA_TEST_ISOLATION_ROOTS for every run. That guard covers the destructive client-configuration commands (setup, uninstall, update) and is inert for suites that spawn nothing; it is not a general filesystem sandbox.
